Get model-specific assessment and a clear estimate before approving work.BOOK A REPAIRBOOK ON WHATSAPPPrefer a quick callback?We’ll call you within 15 minutes.Mobile number+91Request callbackBy requesting a callback, you agree to be contacted about your repair. Privacy policyMOBILE REPAIRStart with the fault.Not a guess.A cracked display, a phone that will not charge or a handset that keeps restarting needs a clear account of what still works. Start with the exact model, symptoms and damage history. An assessment can then connect the findings to a proposed repair, explain the parts and limitations, and identify any risk to stored data before you approve work.Mobile Repair / assessmentILLUSTRATIVEDisplay and touch responseBattery condition and charging pathCamera, microphone and speaker checks01 / DISPLAY & TOUCHScreen replacement and touch problemsDescribe cracked glass, display lines, dark patches and unresponsive touch separately. Mention frame damage, earlier screen work and whether the phone still rings or vibrates. Confirm the proposed display specification, included functions and any model-specific limitations before agreeing to replacement.Discuss this fault 02 / BATTERY & POWERBattery drain and unexpected shutdownsExplain whether the phone loses charge quickly, switches off unexpectedly or has visible swelling. Include approximate age, earlier battery work and the conditions where the issue occurs. A displayed percentage is not a complete diagnosis. Stop charging a swollen or visibly damaged handset.Discuss this fault 03 / CHARGINGCharging port and connection faultsMention the cable and charger used, whether a charging indicator appears and any connection damage or liquid exposure. A phone that will not charge does not automatically need a new battery or port. Do not insert metal tools into the connection or repeatedly test a wet phone.Discuss this fault 04 / CAMERA & AUDIOCamera, microphone and speaker issuesIdentify the affected camera or audio function and whether the problem occurs in one app, during calls or across several functions. Mention external damage and connected accessories. Use examples that do not expose private photos, conversations or personal information.Discuss this fault 05 / START-UP & SOFTWARENo start-up or repeated restartsDescribe whether the phone shows a logo, vibrates, rings or responds to charging. Include damage and update history without assuming either establishes the cause. Explain backup status before any reset, software reinstallation or board work is proposed.Discuss this fault 06 / DAMAGE ASSESSMENTLiquid exposure and impact damageState what happened, when it happened and which functions still work. A damaged phone may have more than one affected area. Avoid opening it, applying improvised heat or repeatedly charging it. Ask about assessment feasibility and data priorities before approving work.Discuss this fault BRANDS WE SERVEYour mobile phone.Familiar brands.Select your brand to request a mobile repair assessment. Share the exact model, issue and any damage so we can confirm repair options and parts availability.AppleSamsungXiaomivivoOPPOrealmeOnePlusMotorolaGooglePOCOiQOONothingTecnoInfinixHuaweiASUSLGAi+MOBILE REPAIR IN BANGALOREYour exact phone.A specific repair scope.Repair options depend on the handset and findings, not only the brand. A useful assessment connects the symptoms to the proposed work, makes part specifications clear and explains what remains uncertain. These are the details to settle before handing over the device or approving replacement parts.Match the exact phone and variantSend the full model, generation and accessible variant information. A brand name, colour or screen size may cover several handsets. For a foldable phone, identify the affected screen. For an imported handset, mention its region if known so parts and scope can be discussed accurately.Compare the proposed part specificationAsk what replacement is proposed, how it matches the model and what it includes. Confirm any limitations involving brightness, touch, cameras, biometric functions or part-related messages. Avoid treating a low advertised component price as the complete fitted repair cost.Confirm assessment and handoverShare your Bangalore locality or PIN code, preferred timing and whether the phone is usable. Agree how assessment and handover would work, whether an inspection charge applies and which tests are included. Availability and repair feasibility need confirmation for the model and fault.Understand the repair assessment process BACKUP, PRIVACY & APPROVALProtect what matters.Agree before a reset.A broken phone can also mean interrupted access to photos, work, contacts and authentication. Put those priorities into the assessment conversation. Keep sensitive information out of the enquiry and ask how testing and any proposed software changes will be handled.Back up what you can accessReview accessible photos, contacts, documents and app data before handover. A phone that will not start may not allow a normal backup. Mention incomplete backups and important files before work is agreed; a screen or battery repair is not a guarantee of data recovery.Keep accounts under your controlDo not send passwords, OTPs, recovery codes or banking details in an enquiry. Discuss how any testing access can be supervised or handled through an appropriate model-supported privacy mode. Such a mode does not replace a backup or guarantee that no reset will be needed.Approve data-impacting steps separatelyAsk whether software work, a reset or board replacement is proposed and what it could mean for stored files. If data preservation is the priority, state that before approving the repair. Recovery feasibility and phone repair should be discussed as distinct scopes.Read the mobile repair booking guide Your phone matters. Start with a clear repair plan.Share the model, symptoms and Bangalore locality. Mention damage and backup status so the assessment conversation covers the device and the data you care about.Request phone repair Share on WhatsAppTHE REPAIR JOURNEYClear steps.Informed decisions.01Describe the phoneShare the exact model, symptoms, damage and earlier repairs. Mention your backup status and data priorities.02Confirm assessmentAgree handover arrangements, inspection charges and scope. The findings establish feasible repair options.03Review and approveCheck parts, labour, limitations and exclusions. Discuss any reset or other data-impacting step before approval.04Check the handoverReview the affected functions, completed-work details and any written repair terms. Check accounts privately.PHONE REPAIR COST & PARTSKnow the full estimate.Approve the right work.A useful quote identifies the handset, proposed work and part specification. Ask what is included in assessment, fitting and relevant function checks. Repair cost is not determined by a screen size or a headline replacement price alone.Inspection and diagnosisConfirm assessment charges and what they cover. Ask which findings support the proposed repair and whether further checks are required. If the scope changes after inspection, agree how revised work and cost will be approved.Parts, labour and exclusionsReview the exact model, part specification, fitting and relevant function checks together. Ask whether any additional damage or separate fault is excluded. Keep the full estimate rather than relying on a component price without labour or limitations.Handover and written termsConfirm any applicable labour or parts warranty, duration, exclusions and reporting process. Ask which reported functions were reviewed and what remains unresolved. Independent repair terms are separate from manufacturer or protection-plan cover.REPAIR OR REPLACE YOUR PHONE?Compare the options.Keep the facts together.Consider the whole phone, your data needs and the complete estimate before deciding. An assessment request starts that discussion; it does not commit you to a replacement screen, battery or internal part.Consider the phone as a wholeWeigh the findings alongside physical condition, battery behaviour, earlier repairs and the functions you need. Age or a cracked screen alone does not decide whether repair is practical. Ask which reported faults the proposed work addresses and what would remain unresolved.Compare the complete estimateReview assessment charges, labour and proposed part specifications together. Compare this with the practical cost of replacing the handset and restoring your apps and data. Do not decide from an advertised part price that leaves the work or exclusions undefined.Keep data needs in the decisionA phone repair and data recovery are different scopes. If files are not backed up, discuss that priority before approving a reset, software reinstallation or board replacement. Confirm parts availability, feasibility and any written repair terms before proceeding.AFTER THE MOBILE REPAIRCheck the functions.Keep the work record.At handover, review the reported problem and what was done. Ask what was tested, what limitations remain and how to report the same symptom again. Retain the record so any future assessment has a clear history.Review the affected functionsAsk which display, touch, charging, audio, camera or connectivity checks relate to the original complaint. Confirm any limitations that remain. A handset that switches on is not by itself proof that every reported fault is resolved.Keep the repair recordRetain the findings, approved scope, part specification and receipt. Confirm any written labour or parts warranty, exclusions and reporting process. Ask how part-related messages or functionality limitations were discussed for the work completed.Check your data and accessReview your own backup and accounts privately after handover. Confirm any agreed software changes and keep authentication under your control. Do not assume that a repair restores inaccessible data or the phone's original resistance to water.Repair aftercare guidance Discuss a separate data recovery enquiry BEFORE HANDOVERA little preparation.A clearer assessment.Identify the full brand, model and variant. Mention an imported or folding handset where relevant.Record symptoms and damage without sharing private screen content, passwords, OTPs or account recovery codes.Back up accessible data. Explain an incomplete backup and any need to discuss data preservation before work.Agree testing and handover arrangements, and remove SIM or removable storage when appropriate for the agreed scope.Keep the charger or accessory details available if relevant. Do not repeatedly charge a swollen, wet or damaged phone.WHAT TO CONFIRMHow much does mobile repair in Bangalore cost?The model, findings, part specification and labour determine the estimate. Confirm inspection charges, fitting, exclusions and any functionality limitations before approval. No fixed screen, battery or board-repair price is quoted on this page.Which mobile brands can I enquire about?The brand cards link to dedicated pages for all 18 listed brands, including Apple, Samsung, Xiaomi, vivo, OPPO, realme, OnePlus, Motorola, Google and Ai+. For another handset, use the enquiry form. Model compatibility and parts availability must be confirmed; a brand listing does not promise support for every device.Will my photos and other data stay on the phone?Data retention cannot be guaranteed. Back up accessible files and discuss incomplete backups before handover. Ask which proposed steps could affect stored data. A phone repair and data recovery are different scopes; agree your priority before a reset, software reinstallation or board work.Do I need to share a password or OTP?Do not put passwords, OTPs, banking details or recovery codes in the enquiry form or WhatsApp message. Discuss testing access and how it can be supervised or handled through a model-supported privacy feature. Keep authentication under your control.Can you replace a screen or battery on my model?Send the full model and describe the damage and affected functions. Ask how the proposed part is matched, its specification and any relevant feature limitations. The diagnosis and availability of suitable parts need confirmation before work is arranged.Can I request help for a phone that will not turn on?Describe any response to power or charging, recent damage and backup status. Do not factory-reset the phone solely to demonstrate a fault. Assessment should establish feasible work and distinguish restoring phone operation from any data-recovery request.Are you an authorized manufacturer service center?No. Numunix provides independent repair assessment. For manufacturer warranty work or official support, contact your phone brand and check existing cover before authorizing independent repair.How long will mobile repair take?Timing depends on assessment, compatible parts and the checks required. Confirm the expected schedule after diagnosis. An enquiry or callback request does not establish a repair completion time.Will the repaired phone still be water resistant?Do not assume its original resistance to water remains unchanged. Ask what sealing and testing, if any, are included and what limitations apply to the specific work. Follow the relevant model guidance and avoid liquid exposure.What should I check when collecting the phone?Review the reported fault and relevant display, touch, charging, camera, audio or connectivity checks. Confirm any unresolved functions, part-related messages and written repair terms. Check your backup and accounts privately, and retain the receipt and work details.Ready to discuss your phone repair?Share the model, symptoms and Bangalore locality. headings.text: Start with the symptom, not a replacement part
Conclusion: make a repair decision with context

pages.mainText: Back to Repair GuidesShareMobile repair:before you bookA cracked screen, weak battery or charging fault needs more than a quick parts quote. Prepare your phone, describe the symptoms and know what to ask before approving work.READ ARTICLEALL REPAIR GUIDESNumunix Repair TeamNovember 1, 20266 min read6 sectionsElectronicsRepair assessmentAftercareTable of ContentsNEED HELP?Tell us the model and symptoms to discuss a repair assessment.Get in touch Table of Contents01Start with the symptom, not a replacement partA phone that will not charge could have a cable, adapter, port, battery or board fault. A cracked display may still have working touch, while an intact screen can fail after impact. Tell the technician what still works, when the problem started and whether there was liquid exposure. This gives the assessment a useful starting point without assuming a particular part is responsible.02Protect your files and accountsBack up accessible photos, contacts and documents before handover. Remove SIM and memory cards when they are not required for testing. Do not send account passwords, bank details or one-time codes in an enquiry. Ask whether testing can happen with supervised access or a temporary account. A screen repair does not automatically include data recovery, and a device that will not start may not allow a normal backup.03Describe charging and battery behaviourExplain whether the phone charges only at an angle, becomes unusually hot, shuts down at a displayed charge level or loses charge while idle. Use only undamaged compatible chargers and do not continue testing a swollen battery. If there is swelling, smoke or a burning smell, stop using the device and arrange professional assessment rather than trying to open it.YOUR REPAIR, YOUR DECISIONNeed a repair assessment?Share the model, symptoms and location. Review the options and estimate before approving work.REQUEST ASSESSMENT04Read the estimate carefullyAsk which part is proposed, whether it is compatible with the exact model, what labour includes and whether inspection charges apply. Confirm any limitations involving display brightness, touch, camera functions or water resistance after opening. The lowest headline quote is not necessarily the lowest total cost if it excludes fitting or follow-up checks.05Check the functions at handoverReview the repaired function alongside touch response, charging, camera, microphone and speakers where relevant. Include the serial label and approximate age when available.For a twin-tub machine, describe the wash tub and spin tub separately. If one function still works, say so. Explain whether the affected tub does nothing, starts then stops, or makes a new sound; avoid testing with a lid switch bypassed.For an automatic Godrej washer, note the programme and last completed stage. A problem that appears only after filling needs a different description from one that prevents the machine from starting. Mention earlier repairs and whether the symptom changed afterwards.AN EXAMPLE ENQUIRYDescribe the sequence, not just the symptom.A Godrej twin-tub washer washes normally but the spin tub stops early. Do not treat phone repair as a promise of data recovery.Parts and functionalityAsk how the part matches the full model, its agreed specification and what functions or messages may be affected. Review labour, exclusions and any change in scope before approval.Checks and written termsAgree which reported functions will be reviewed after work. Ask for any applicable labour or parts warranty and its exclusions in writing, along with the completed-work record.REPAIR OR REPLACE?Make the decision.With the facts in hand.Whether to repair your Apple phone depends on more than a single faulty part. Use the assessment to weigh the condition of the device, the proposed repair and the practical alternatives. An enquiry begins that conversation; it does not commit you to replacement parts or repair work.Consider the phone as a wholeWeigh the findings alongside physical condition, battery behaviour, earlier repairs and the functions you need. Age or a cracked screen alone does not decide whether repair is practical. Ask which reported faults the proposed work addresses and what would remain unresolved.Compare the complete estimateReview assessment charges, labour and proposed part specifications together. Compare this with the practical cost of replacing the handset and restoring your apps and data. Do not decide from an advertised part price that leaves the work or exclusions undefined.Keep data needs in the decisionA phone repair and data recovery are different scopes. If files are not backed up, discuss that priority before approving a reset, software reinstallation or board replacement. Confirm parts availability, feasibility and any written repair terms before proceeding.Before replacing a part on your Apple phoneAsk which checks support the diagnosis, how the proposed part is matched to the full model and whether it is new, refurbished or another agreed specification. Confirm the part description, labour and any exclusions in the estimate. If the diagnosis changes during work, agree how the revised scope and cost will be approved.Manufacturer warranty, extended cover and independent repair terms are separate questions. If you have existing cover, check its terms with the provider before authorizing independent work. Parts availability and any repair warranty need confirmation for the specific job. Discuss your Apple repair enquiry AFTER THE REPAIRCheck the result.Keep the details.A useful handover explains the work completed on your Apple phone and what to do next. Confirm any limitations that remain. A handset that switches on is not by itself proof that every reported fault is resolved.02Keep the repair recordRetain the findings, approved scope, part specification and receipt. Confirm any written labour or parts warranty, exclusions and reporting process. Ask how part-related messages or functionality limitations were discussed for the work completed.03Check your data and accessReview your own backup and accounts privately after handover. Confirm any agreed software changes and keep authentication under your control. Do not assume that a repair restores inaccessible data or the phone's original resistance to water.Read the repair aftercare guide BEFORE YOUR ASSESSMENTA few useful details.A better starting point.Share the exact Apple phone model and variant. Do not include passwords, OTPs, recovery codes or account credentials in the enquiry.Back up accessible data before handover where possible. Keep sensitive content out of photos and videos.Discuss the handover and testing arrangements. Remove SIM and removable storage when appropriate, and keep control of your accounts.Stop charging a swollen, wet or visibly damaged phone. Check official support and existing manufacturer or protection-plan cover before arranging independent work.What details help with my Apple phone repair?Share the full iPhone model and generation, not just its colour or storage size. Mention earlier screen or battery work, physical damage and whether the device still starts. A photo of the exterior can help identify the model without sharing a serial number publicly.Will my data stay on the phone during repair?Data retention cannot be guaranteed. Back up accessible files and discuss data priorities before any reset, software reinstallation or board work is approved. Ask which steps may affect data and distinguish the repair scope from any separate data-recovery request.Do I need to share an account password or OTP?Do not put passwords, OTPs, recovery codes or account credentials in the booking form or WhatsApp enquiry. Discuss any access needed for testing and how it can be supervised or handled through a model-supported privacy mode. Keep authentication under your control.How much does Apple mobile repair cost?The exact model, diagnosis, part specification and labour determine the estimate. Confirm assessment charges, exclusions and any functionality limitations before approval. No fixed repair price is quoted on this page.Can a screen be changed without replacing other parts?That depends on the model and findings. Describe touch, image and frame damage separately and mention prior repairs. Ask what checks support the proposed scope and which features or messages may be affected by the chosen replacement.Can you repair an imported or older phone?Share the full model, region variant if known and repair history. Assessment options, compatible parts and repair feasibility need confirmation for the particular handset; a brand listing does not guarantee support for every model.How long will the repair take?Timing depends on assessment, suitable parts and the checks required. Confirm the expected schedule after diagnosis. An enquiry or callback request does not establish a completion time.Will the phone still be water resistant after repair?Do not assume its original resistance to water remains unchanged. Ask what sealing work and testing, if any, are included and what limitations apply. Keep the repaired phone away from liquid unless you have clear model-specific guidance.What warranty applies to the repair?Confirm any written labour or parts warranty for the specific job, including duration, exclusions and how to report the same symptom again. Independent repair terms are separate from manufacturer cover and protection plans.BOOK APPLE MOBILE REPAIRTell us what stopped.Let’s take a look.Share your Apple model, the issue and preferred timing.
